name: Hayase Yuuka Love is War
source:
A bomb exploded and Sensei was called to investigate the scene. Yuuka, fearing the worst might happen to her beloved Sensei, grows anxious and rushes out to confess her love for Sensei, only to find other girls who are against it do everything to block her way?!

Help Yuuka fight her way through the obsessive Midori, overprotective Momoi, vengeful Yuzu, and One-Punch Girl Aris!

Will you be able to help Yuuka win the war for Sensei's heart and bring her love to fruition? Or will you let her fail and miss this golden opportunity as time runs out?
translation:
炸弹爆炸，老师被叫去调查现场。优香担心她心爱的老师会发生最坏的情况，她焦急地冲出去向老师表白，却发现其他反对的女孩千方百计挡住她的去路？！

帮助优香战胜痴迷的绿、过度保护的桃井、复仇心重的柚子和一拳超女阿丽丝！

你能帮助优香赢得老师的心之战并让她的爱情开花结果吗？还是会让她失败，随着时间的流逝而错过这个千载难逢的机会？
